teaser: You wire your first query() call and watch the SDK run the whole agent loop for you: reason, tool, result, repeat, then a ResultMessage.
takeaways: The Agent SDK owns the agent loop and ships built-in tools; with the plain Messages API you write the loop yourself.
Entry points are query() or ClaudeSDKClient; the SDK streams SystemMessage, AssistantMessage, UserMessage (tool results) and ResultMessage.
Each tool call passes a gate in order: hooks, then deny rules, then permission mode / allow rules, then can_use_tool.
The loop ends when Claude replies without tool calls, max_turns is hit, or an error occurs; ResultMessage carries cost and session id.
